title: QUẢN TRỊ KINH DOANH NHÀ HÀNG

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature and characteristics of restaurant business operations to meet customer needs in hospitality and food service industries.
Apply marketing strategies and techniques to manage restaurant operations effectively.
Organize and manage restaurant operations, including menu planning, procurement, inventory management, food preparation, and direct service.
Manage human resources in restaurants, including recruitment, training, and leadership.
Implement service management practices in restaurant operations.
Develop strategic plans and marketing plans for restaurant businesses.
Analyze real-world scenarios in the restaurant business market in Vietnam.
